fixture: A repo whose .eposforge/backlog/config.toml has prefix = "APP" and whose .eposforge/ideas/ideas.md header declares Area vocabulary capture | organize | share | other. Existing entries: APP-IDEA-001 'Offline reading queue' (idea), APP-IDEA-002 'Import highlights from e-reader exports' (idea), APP-IDEA-003 'Public reading-list pages' (rejected — no audience for public lists yet). Backlog item APP-014 'Sync reading list across devices' is open.

test_cases.name: single_idea_capture
test_cases.input: Add to ideas: it'd be nice to tag books by mood so I can pick something light after a long week.
assertions: Appends exactly one entry headed '## APP-IDEA-004: <Title>' (colon right after the ID, one space) at the end of .eposforge/ideas/ideas.md
Every field label sits on its own line as **Label**, with the value on the following line(s)
Area is one value from the header vocabulary (capture, organize, share or other)
Status is idea and Phase is one of core, next, later, explore
Has an Edges field (with '- none yet' if no edge is proposed), not a Related field
Acceptance criteria are sparse or TBD; no invented requirements
Does not add effort, priority, Depends on or Blocks fields

test_cases.name: duplicate_merge
test_cases.input: Napkin note: I want to pull my e-reader highlights into the app automatically.
assertions: Identifies the overlap with APP-IDEA-002
Refines APP-IDEA-002 (adds a Source line and merges the note) instead of appending a new entry
No new APP-IDEA-NNN ID is assigned
Reports that the existing entry was refined

test_cases.name: rejected_duplicate_surfaces_reason
test_cases.input: Capture this idea: let people publish their reading list as a public web page.
assertions: Finds the rejected entry APP-IDEA-003
Shows the operator the rejection reason and asks whether anything has changed
Does not append a new duplicate entry without confirmation

test_cases.name: multi_idea_split
test_cases.input: Food for future development: (1) a yearly reading recap, (2) let a friend co-edit a shared list, (3) dark mode for the reader view.
assertions: Writes three separate entries, APP-IDEA-004, APP-IDEA-005 and APP-IDEA-006, in that order
Each entry has its own Story, Area from the header vocabulary, and Status idea
Does not merge distinct ideas into one entry

test_cases.name: edge_proposal_and_backfill
test_cases.input: Notional feature: download books for a flight so the queue works without signal, and keep them in step with my other devices.
assertions: Proposes an overlaps edge to APP-IDEA-001 (or refines it as a duplicate) with a one-line reason
If overlaps: APP-IDEA-001 is written on the new entry, the same edit adds '- overlaps: <new ID>' to APP-IDEA-001
Proposes an edge toward backlog item APP-014 (overlaps or depends-on) and does not edit the APP-014 backlog entry
Uses only edge types from the closed vocabulary
Writes no inverse edges such as required-by or has-part

test_cases.name: dangling_edge
test_cases.input: Add to ideas: reading streak badges. It depends on APP-IDEA-042, the stats dashboard idea.
assertions: Detects that APP-IDEA-042 does not exist in the ideas file or the backlog
Does not write a depends-on edge to a non-existent ID
Tells the operator the target is missing and asks whether to capture the stats dashboard as its own idea first

test_cases.name: promote_request
test_cases.input: Promote APP-IDEA-002 to the backlog — I keep re-typing highlights by hand every week.
assertions: Treats the stated repeated pain as meeting the promotion bar (or confirms it with the operator)
Writes an ordinary backlog item in the repo's backlog format with the next backlog ID, citing APP-IDEA-002
Sets APP-IDEA-002 Status to 'promoted → <new backlog ID>'
Adds '- promoted-to: <new backlog ID>' to APP-IDEA-002's Edges
Leaves APP-IDEA-002 in the ideas file

test_cases.name: reject_request
test_cases.input: Reject APP-IDEA-001, offline mode is out of scope for this app.
assertions: Sets Status to 'rejected — offline mode is out of scope for this app' (or an equivalent one-line reason)
Leaves the entry and its edges in the file

test_cases.name: repo_without_ideas_file
test_cases.fixture_override: Same repo, but .eposforge/ideas/ideas.md does not exist.
test_cases.input: Capture this idea: a barcode scanner to add books quickly.
assertions: Says the ideas file does not exist and offers to create it with the header
Asks the operator for the Area vocabulary (a draft suggestion is fine) and the Serves target
Does not create the file before the operator agrees
After agreement, the first entry is APP-IDEA-001 and the header states this is not the backlog

test_cases.name: repo_without_backlog_config
test_cases.fixture_override: A repo with no .eposforge/ directory at all.
test_cases.input: Add to ideas: a weekly digest email of what I read.
assertions: Asks the operator for an ID prefix
Offers to create only .eposforge/ideas/ideas.md and does not scaffold a backlog

test_cases.name: analyze_register
test_cases.input: What's in the ideas register — any clusters or conflicts I should decide on?
assertions: Reads Edges as a graph: groups clusters via part-of and overlaps, lists depends-on chains
Lists conflicts-with and alternative-to pairs as open choices without resolving them
Reports dangling or one-sided symmetric edges if any
Does not edit the file
